title: Event envelope
description: Every ServiceDesk event has exactly these top-level fields. Each event schema narrows `type`, `version` and `payload`.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Consumers de-duplicate on this value.

occurredAt.description: When the state change happened (UTC, RFC 3339), not when the event was published.

actorId.description: The user whose action caused the event.

version.description: Schema version of this event type. Bumped only for breaking changes.
